overview.title: What is Alpha City?
overview.text: Alpha City is a startup city developer building frontier cities in Lusophone Africa, designed for businesses and residents seeking 21st-century governance.

overview.title: Who joins Alpha City?
overview.text: Alpha City draws entrepreneurs, technologists, and investors who want to operate in a low-friction legal environment purpose-built for 21st-century commerce and governance. The initiative is equally designed to create economic opportunity for local populations - from entry-level employment to senior business roles - making it distinct from traditional Special Economic Zone projects that primarily benefit foreign capital.

history.text:
Alpha City Inc. was founded in 2024 by Bradford Cross, a technology entrepreneur who spent more than two decades building and investing in AI companies in Silicon Valley. Cross co-founded deep-tech VC DCVC and previously exited companies including Prismatic (acquired by LinkedIn) and Flightcaster (acquired by NextJump) before pivoting to what he describes as the hardest systems challenge: building better government.

The company was incubated by [Pronomos Capital](https://www.pronomos.vc/), the only institutional venture fund focused on the startup cities space, with Patri Friedman serving as co-founder. Tom Bell, the leading legal authority on zone law in both academia and industry, joined to architect Alpha City's Special Development Zone Law - the regulatory framework the company brings to every partner country.

Alpha City targets Lusophone (Portuguese-speaking) Africa as its first expansion territory, where the team has cultivated relationships with national governments over years of prior work. In its first twelve months, the company signed deals with three host countries that earmarked 100 square kilometers of land valued at more than $1 billion for initial city builds. National legislation and land grants for the first project were targeted for completion by end of 2024, with construction planned to begin in 2025.

location:
Alpha City is building its first frontier cities in Lusophone Africa - Portuguese-speaking countries in West and Central Africa where the team has established government relationships. The [Bissagos Islands of Guinea-Bissau](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bijag%C3%B3s_Islands) represent one of the candidate locations, offering equatorial positioning, coastal access, and greenfield land for a master-planned urban zone. Equatorial sites give Alpha City's cities advantages in solar energy, strategic logistics, and - where applicable - space launch economics.

Because these cities are in pre-development, precise infrastructure maps and facility layouts have not yet been made public. Each Alpha City master plan is mixed-use and industry-specific, built on a shared Special Development Zone legal framework that gives residents and businesses a degree of regulatory and tax autonomy negotiated directly with the host nation.
duration:
Alpha City's frontier cities are built for permanent residence and long-term business operation, not temporary or cohort-based stays. There is no minimum or maximum stay tied to participation. When cities become operational, residents and businesses will establish themselves under the city's Special Development Zone legal framework, with the option to remain indefinitely.

The first cities are currently in pre-development. People interested in early participation can join the waiting list to receive updates when residency and business registration opens.

howToEnter.text: Alpha City's first cities are in pre-development. The current path to getting involved is to join the early access list on the official Substack at [alphacity.substack.com](https://alphacity.substack.com/p/early-access). Signing up places you in line to receive updates on site selection, legal framework details, and when residency and business registration opens for the first city. faqs.question: What is Alpha City?
faqs.answer: Alpha City is a startup cities company building a federation of frontier cities across Lusophone Africa. It applies Special Development Zone frameworks and Silicon Valley execution speed to create new urban environments where government functions more like a well-run product - iterative, user-focused, and accountable.

faqs.question: Who founded Alpha City?
faqs.answer: Alpha City was founded in 2024 by Bradford Cross, a Silicon Valley AI veteran who co-founded deep-tech VC DCVC and exited companies including Prismatic (acquired by LinkedIn) and Flightcaster (acquired by NextJump). The company was incubated by Pronomos Capital with co-founder Patri Friedman, and Tom Bell - the leading academic and industry authority on zone law - designed Alpha City's Special Development Zone legal framework.

faqs.question: Where will Alpha City's first cities be built?
faqs.answer: Alpha City's first cities are planned for Lusophone (Portuguese-speaking) Africa. In its first twelve months, the company signed deals with three host countries that have collectively earmarked 100 square kilometers of land for initial builds. The [Bissagos Islands of Guinea-Bissau](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bijag%C3%B3s_Islands) are one of the specific locations under active development consideration.

faqs.question: What is a Special Development Zone?
faqs.answer: A Special Development Zone (SDZ) is a form of Special Economic Zone with extended legal and regulatory autonomy. Alpha City's Zone Law architect Tom Bell designed the SDZ framework that the company brings to every partner country. Inside an SDZ, residents and businesses operate under a distinct legal regime - often with lower taxes, streamlined regulations, and governance designed for 21st-century economic activity - while the host nation retains formal sovereignty.

faqs.question: How is Alpha City different from a traditional SEZ?
faqs.answer: Traditional SEZs are created by governments as policy tools and are constrained by bureaucratic timelines and political cycles. Alpha City treats city-building as a product - applying fast iteration and user-centered design to the governance layer itself. The company privatizes execution while keeping formal legal authority with the host nation, preserving legitimacy while enabling faster decision-making and clear accountability.

faqs.question: Who is Alpha City designed for?
faqs.answer: Alpha City targets two groups: global builders and entrepreneurs who want to operate under a lower-friction legal framework, and local populations who gain from the jobs and economic mobility the cities create. The city designs include employment from entry-level to senior roles, making them distinct from projects primarily aimed at attracting foreign capital with limited local benefit.

faqs.question: How can I get involved with Alpha City right now?
faqs.answer: The primary path is to join the [early access list](https://alphacity.substack.com/p/early-access) on Alpha City's Substack. This keeps you informed about project milestones, site selection, and when residency and business registration opens. You can also follow the company's SEZ research and city-building analysis at [alphacity.io](https://alphacity.io/).

faqs.question: What role does Pronomos Capital play in Alpha City?
faqs.answer: Pronomos Capital is the only institutional venture fund focused on the startup cities space and the firm that incubated Alpha City. Its founder Patri Friedman, who has worked on startup cities since 2001, is also an Alpha City co-founder. This gives Alpha City access to a global network of city-building investors, advisors, and government contacts built over more than two decades.

faqs.question: What industries will Alpha City's cities focus on?
faqs.answer: Each Alpha City master plan is mixed-use and includes a tailored set of industries matched to the city's geography and the host country's economic priorities. While a shared Special Development Zone legal foundation applies to all cities, the specific industry focus - whether finance, logistics, technology, manufacturing, or hospitality - varies by location. Equatorial sites offer particular advantages for energy and logistics-intensive industries.

faqs.question: When will the first Alpha City be operational?
faqs.answer: Alpha City targeted national legislation and the land grant for its first project by end of 2024, with construction to begin in 2025. No confirmed public opening date has been announced as of mid-2026. Joining the [early access list](https://alphacity.substack.com/p/early-access) is the best way to receive updates when the timeline firms up.
